title: Orbit review output
description: Independent review findings (spec section 12), adapted for strict structured output: nullable fields are listed as required and typed with a null union. The reviewer edits nothing; findings are claims to be converted into testable checks, never decided by vote.

candidate_revision.description: The exact candidate revision reviewed, as given in the review packet.

id.description: Category prefix and number, for example SEC-1.

category.description: For example authorization, correctness, test-adequacy, scope, performance.

location.description: path:line, or null for a finding about the change as a whole.

suggested_validation.description: A test or check that would confirm or refute the claim.
